relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Electron microscopy and Western blot studies found that postsynaptic GluA1 (a subtype of ionotropic glutamate receptors) on the postsynaptic membrane was decreased by acute capsaicin treatment.

relationships.subject: TRPV1+ primary afferent fibers
relationships.evidence_quote: fibers in the spinal dorsal horn triggers exaggerated glutamate release and induces acute pain

key_findings: Capsaicin activation of TRPV1+ fibers attenuated postsynaptic glutamate responses in dorsal horn neurons.
Postsynaptic GluA1 on the membrane decreased after acute capsaicin, possibly a homeostatic mechanism.
